output.review_comment:
Fixes 1 and 2 are correct and match the docstring. Mixed-case words like "iPhone" and "NASA" are now kept as written, and a small word at the end is now capitalized, just like one at the start.

Fix 3 (capitalizing the word after a colon) should not merge as written. The agent says it added this only to make test_subtitle_after_colon pass, and nothing in the docstring describes it. The docstring only capitalizes a small word when it is the first or last word of the whole text, so following it gives 'Notes From the Field: a Year of Remote Work'. The teammate said the docstrings are the source of truth, so this is code written to pass one test that contradicts the spec.

The agent was right to point out the conflict, but it shouldn't have picked a side on its own. Someone on the team needs to decide which is right:
- If the docstring is right, the test is wrong, and changing it needs the teammate's sign-off, since they asked for the tests to stay as they are.
- If colon handling is wanted, update the docstring to describe it first, then keep the code.

Until that's decided, please drop the after_colon logic, or hold the PR until the docstring is updated to cover it.
